# Data Visualisation

11 rules in this category.

## data-visualisation-08B67FF8

**MUST_NOT:** Do not crop, stretch, or otherwise distort charts within an infographic.

*Distorted charts give a false impression of the available data.*

Sources:
- https://www.nngroup.com/articles/designing-effective-infographics/

---

## data-visualisation-16406877

**MUST:** Clearly show when a chart scale has been truncated.

*Visible truncation disclosure prevents viewers from misreading exaggerated trends.*

Sources:
- https://www.nngroup.com/articles/designing-effective-infographics/

---

## data-visualisation-26478FE2

**MUST_NOT:** Do not use chart scales that misrepresent differences between data points.

*Inaccurate scale gives an incorrect impression of the original data.*

Sources:
- https://www.nngroup.com/articles/designing-effective-infographics/

---

## data-visualisation-7BC4321A

**MUST:** Scale charts to show data differences and communicate the value range accurately.

*Accurate scaling prevents misrepresentation of the underlying dataset.*

Sources:
- https://www.nngroup.com/articles/designing-effective-infographics/

---

## data-visualisation-9A7F184F

**MUST_NOT:** Do not truncate the y-axis when users must compare different values on the graph.

*Truncation exaggerates differences and leads to erroneous relative-value inferences.*

Sources:
- https://www.nngroup.com/articles/designing-effective-infographics/

---

## data-visualisation-C773805E

**MUST:** Present data clearly and truthfully in information graphics.

*Informational honesty is the most important principle when designing infographics.*

Sources:
- https://www.nngroup.com/articles/designing-effective-infographics/

---

## data-visualisation-034259EA

**SHOULD_NOT:** Do not force a visualization to begin at zero when another logical starting point exists.

*Zero is not always a natural baseline; forcing it can obscure meaningful variation.*

Sources:
- https://www.nngroup.com/articles/designing-effective-infographics/

---

## data-visualisation-0D7B85EF

**SHOULD:** Choose chart scale balancing trend clarity with accurate dataset scale representation.

*Scale choices must show trends without distorting the magnitude of values.*

Sources:
- https://www.nngroup.com/articles/designing-effective-infographics/

---

## data-visualisation-EE4F4CBB

**SHOULD:** Show a baseline state of the dataset on the y-axis.

*A meaningful baseline anchors interpretation of values and changes over time.*

Sources:
- https://www.nngroup.com/articles/designing-effective-infographics/

---

## data-visualisation-F844497F

**SHOULD:** Ensure every infographic element conveys meaningful information.

*Charts and imagery should carry data or explanatory value rather than decorative filler.*

Sources:
- https://www.nngroup.com/articles/designing-effective-infographics/

---

## data-visualisation-11D48028

**SHOULD:** Support describe-a-graph mode that generates a graph stub from text.

*Text-to-graph stubs let users sketch diagram intent without drawing.*
